title: 1 · Printed book page (validation)
why: Typical page from the same kind of source as training: two-sided printed book, phone photo.
gloss: "6 / Torn little boots, / ragged galoshes. / Who needs boots, / run to the miracle tree!" (Chukovsky's children's poem "The Miracle Tree")

title: 2 · Handwritten student sheet (validation)
why: Braille written by hand with a slate, irregular spacing and dot depth.
gloss: "but the birds have stopped singing, / the flowers have faded, / the rays have paled, / the zephyrs have gone." (the ⠿⠿ marks are the Braille erase sign the writer used to cross out mistakes)

title: 3 · Median user upload (test)
why: The middle test image by official char-F1 (0.931): what a typical real upload looks like. This page is a chemistry table: the words and numbers are read correctly, but every vertical table border '|' (dots 4-5-6) is read as 'л' (dots 1-2-3). A lone column of dots is ambiguous without the cell grid around it, a genuine model error that accounts for most of this page's CER.
gloss: "Table 8. Physical properties: simple substance | boiling temperature (°C): fluorine −188, chlorine −34, bromine 59, iodine 185" (a school chemistry table)

title: 4 · User upload that the official metric calls bad (test)
why: Official char-F1 is low here although nearly every cell is found: the test labels use narrower boxes, so correct reads fall under IoU 0.5. Compare the texts yourself.
gloss: "...nor ladders, nothing helped them reach the bottom of the cave. The green valley of the mountain..."

title: 5 · Worst user upload (test), a genuine failure
why: The page is photographed so that dots appear as dents; the model learned dents (back side) as background and skips most cells.
gloss: "Women's work in the family: spinning, weaving, knitting, cooking. The modern family..."
